assets.label: 普通僵尸 · 西方旧衣无伤口版
assets.prompt: Create a NON-GORY RTS game character concept turnaround, based on the silhouette and proportions of the referenced ordinary zombie. User explicitly wants a NEW safe alternative Western old-clothing variant. Three equal separated panels in one wide image: FRONT, exact LEFT SIDE, BACK, same single character, same scale, neutral light grey background, no text. Preserve skinny emaciated long limbs, gently hunched stooped posture, grey ashen skin, small non-glowing eyes, understated undead expression. NO exposed wounds, NO blood, NO exposed organs, NO torn skin. Replace Eastern costume completely: short messy loose hair without topknot or headwrap, worn Western medieval peasant long-sleeved muted grey-brown tunic with intact lining, simple aged brown leather belt, faded charcoal trousers, simple battered leather shoes; no wrap collar, no Eastern leg puttees. Clothing worn and dusty but covering body fully, no injury visible. Cool grey-blue shadows, subtle natural brown cloth warmth, grounded believable textured game concept art, not whitewashed, not cartoon or toy. Arms held slightly away from torso so Tripo can distinguish them; hands simple. Preserve full feet and all silhouette within each panel. Three views describe exactly one model, not three different zombie designs.
assets.user_approved_alternative: 不露伤口的西方旧衣版

visual_review.notes: 正侧背完整；弯背瘦削、西方系带旧衣、长裤皮鞋，无血或伤口；灰败皮肤与微暖旧布。
